# netactuate_vpc_gateway_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages a VPC Gateway Firewall Rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_gateway_firewall_rule" "example" {
  direction  = "inbound"
  ip_version = 4
  vpc_id     = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `direction` (String) Traffic direction (inbound or outbound)
- `ip_version` (Number) IP version for this rule (4 or 6)
- `vpc_id` (Number) The ID of the parent VPC

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the rule
- `network` (String) Network CIDR to match (e.g. 172.16.0.0/12)
- `port_end` (Number) End of the port range
- `port_start` (Number) Start of the port range
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to match (TCP, UDP, or ICMP)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rule_id` (Number) The firewall rule ID assigned by the API

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_gateway_firewall_rule.example 12345
```
